packageRules.description: End-to-end suite npm dependencies, separate so a Playwright bump never holds back the web app

Android shell (android/): Gradle plugins and libraries, grouped. The Android Gradle Plugin, the compile/target SDK (Play raises the minimum target API every year, see docs/ANDROID.md) and androidbrowserhelper change the shipped shell: build with ci-android.yml and test on a device before merging.

The JDK that runs Gradle (java-version in ci-android.yml and release-android.yml) moves with Gradle and the Android Gradle Plugin: a JDK bump alone fails against an older Gradle (Gradle 8.11 cannot run on JDK 25). It is therefore grouped with the android dependencies.
The Go toolchain in server/Dockerfile (golang image) and server/go.mod (go directive, which setup-go reads in ci-server.yml) move together so CI tests with the Go the image is built with
Node major: the build image (web/Dockerfile), setup-node in the workflows and @types/node (which must match the Node major in use) change together in one PR

Node major, setup-node's node-version in the workflows: Renovate sees it as dep `node` of the package actions/node-versions, so the rule above (which matches packageName) misses it and it got its own PR. Matching the dep name puts it in the same PR as the Dockerfile and @types/node.

BLOCKED: dev/CI Postgres follows production (CloudPirates Postgres 18.6). Bump docker-compose.yml, ci-server.yml (services.postgres.image) and the example in server/internal/store/doc.go by hand, in one change, after production moves. Postgres 18+ images keep the data under /var/lib/postgresql/<major>/docker: a volume made by an older major is refused, so remind developers to run `docker compose down -v` once.

SvelteKit toolchain: @sveltejs/kit, @sveltejs/adapter-static (its peer is the Kit major) and @vite-pwa/sveltekit (the PWA/service worker plugin, peer @sveltejs/kit) only work together, so a major of any of them arrives in one PR. Check that the build still emits a service worker: `npm run build`, then `npx vitest run src/lib/pwa.test.ts src/lib/security.test.ts` (see web/README.md, PWA). Kit majors also change the configuration (Kit 3: no svelte.config.js, `#lib` instead of `$lib`).

BLOCKED (TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and ships no JavaScript API): typescript-eslint refuses it (peer typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, throws 'does not support TS 7.0'), svelte-check 4 (peer ^5 || ^6) only runs it as an alias next to TypeScript 6 with --tsgo, and @sveltejs/kit peers ^5.3.3 || ^6. Retry when `npm view typescript-eslint peerDependencies` and `npm view svelte-check peerDependencies` accept typescript 7.
